_comment: Sector 01 / Left Wing / Floor 1 - RECTANGLE STUDY V6 (review map) built from the Greybox Build Sheet (Nov 6, 2026) and plan board 07 v2. Coordinates are the sheet's: metres from the interior north-west corner, +X east, +Y SOUTH, Z up; UE X = X*100, UE Y = Y*100. The generator (Content/Python/cw_rectstudy_v2.py StudyV2 + cw_rectstudy_v6.py V6 layer) uses compass letters with N = +Y, so facings in this file are generator letters (plan south = N). NOT the accepted M1 map, NOT V1-V5.

meta.note: Both tiers belong to Sector Floor 1 (lower ceiling 3.6 m, upper floor 3.9 m, upper ceiling 7.5 m, roof slab 7.5-7.8 m). Only the secured door D07 and the sealed arrival door D03 are blocked.
